row: Equine Bodywork Online offers horse owners techniques to relieve tension, develop proper muscle engagement, and deepen your relationship with your equine partner. Developed by a professional equine massage therapist and bodyworker, Kara O'Laughlin, LAMP, walks horse owners through daily routines to make sure your horse in comfortable and performing at its peak. To learn more, visit https://www.equinebodyworkonline.com
